proposed.explanation: The investor currently holds 300 shares of ETEL and 20,000.00 EGP in cash. According to the company's FY2025 financial statements, operating revenues reached 106,672,946,000 EGP, gross profit was 44,839,110,000 EGP, and net profit for the year was 22,578,063,000 EGP. The basic and diluted earnings per share were 11.93 EGP. Total assets stand at 225,882,527,000 EGP and total equity at 63,687,826,000 EGP. Given the strong financial performance and the investor's medium risk tolerance with a 5-7 year horizon, holding the existing position in ETEL is appropriate. No additional shares are bought to ensure the portfolio remains diversified and does not violate the rule that no single company may exceed half of the portfolio's total value after a buy.
